subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Group guided: reads aloud from own book; monitors self; shows understanding of punctuation when reading aloud

show.line: Marks tell us how to read! A question mark asks. Is it a dog? An exclamation mark shouts. Run!

rounds.prompt: Which sentence should be read loud and excited?
rounds.praise: Look, a shark! Loud and excited.

rounds.prompt: Read this with a big voice.
What is the little dot at the end of a sentence called? Say it.
Where do you stop and take a breath? Tap the full stop.

hints: A question goes up at the end. Can the frog hop?
Full stop means stop. Take a little breath.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this. Is the cat wet?
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Is the cat wet. Flat, like a stone.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! It has a question mark. Is the cat wet? Up at the end!
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together, like a question. Is the cat wet?

parent_line: Can read a question, an exclamation and a full stop with the right voice.
